user.title: Marketplace Guard Gate
user.description: Marketplace Guard {version} answers in this Home Assistant. Before anything the Marketplace installs can load, the gate asks it. What the app would quarantine is not installed: the Marketplace puts back what was there, and the install dialog says why.

abort.single_instance_allowed: The gate is already set up.
abort.app_missing: The Marketplace Guard app has not reported itself in this Home Assistant. The gate asks the app about each install, so it needs it: install the app Marketplace Guard (2.6.0 or later, under Settings → Apps), start it, then add the gate again.
abort.app_unreadable: The report of the Marketplace Guard app cannot be read. Restart the app, which writes it again, then add the gate again.
abort.app_stale: The Marketplace Guard app ({version}) last reported itself {minutes} minutes ago, so it is not running. Start it, then add the gate again.
abort.app_incompatible: The Marketplace Guard app ({version}) speaks another request format than this gate. Update the app and the gate to the same version, then add the gate again.

data.on_no_answer: When Marketplace Guard does not answer

data_description.on_no_answer: Refuse: nothing is installed while the app is stopped. Allow: the install goes ahead unchecked, as without the gate.
data_description.timeout: A scan takes seconds; large repositories and the dependency check can take longer.
